objective_value: <float> Total path cost, combining linear traversal costs and quadratic interaction costs of all selected arcs.

solution_arcs.id: <int> Unique identifier of this arc selected in the path.
solution_arcs.from_node: <int> Identifier of the node where this selected arc originates.
solution_arcs.to_node: <int> Identifier of the node where this selected arc terminates.
